name: Vercel Edge Config & KV
description: Vercel Edge Config for ultra-low latency feature flags and KV storage for fast key-value data at the edge.

requiredSecrets.name: KV_REST_API_URL
requiredSecrets.reason: Vercel KV (Upstash Redis) REST API URL

postInstallNotes:
1. Create Edge Config and KV stores in the Vercel dashboard and link them to your project.
2. `getFlag('maintenance_mode')` reads from Edge Config — changes propagate globally in milliseconds without redeployment.
3. `cache.set('session:xyz', data, 3600)` stores data in KV with a 1-hour TTL.
